name: Otomaru Heishi
source:
A young man who's energetic, lively and loves the company of others. The leader of the Norn members of his age group, Heishi isn't double--faced and is the life of the group. He can quickly move on from the bad things that happen to him.

His power is telepathy. When his emotions heighten, the voices in his heart "leak" out and can be heard by others. For this reason, Heishi is bad at keeping secrets. His true thoughts and feelings leak out, and can incite the wrath of groups of girls.

His route is only accessible when the player selects Nanami as the protagonist.

[Translation of his [URL=http://www.otomate.jp/norn9/vita/chara/?page=heishi]official website profile[/URL]]
